about.intro_content: Prof. Yong-Gao Mou is Chief Surgeon and Director of the Department of Neurosurgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, with over 30 years of clinical experience and recognition as a Clinical Medical Scientist and Chief Expert in Glioma.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Mou has trained more than 30 master's and doctoral students, led over 10 research projects including National Natural Science Foundation of China grants, and published more than 100 academic papers in journals including the Journal of Neurosurgery and Neuro-Oncology. He completed postdoctoral fellowship training at Kaohsiung Medical University and a visiting scholarship at MD Anderson Cancer Center, USA. His research spans glioma molecular subtyping using AI-integrated models, brain metastasis treatment outcomes, and risk factor studies using Mendelian randomization. He received the First Prize of the Guangdong Provincial Medical Science and Technology Award and the National Famous Doctor – Outstanding Contribution Award from People's Daily.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Yong-Gao Mou

items.question: Does Prof. Yong-Gao Mou accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to glioma or brain metastases at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Mou's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Mou specialises in microsurgery and comprehensive treatment of glioma and brain metastases, combining surgery, chemotherapy, targeted therapy and immunotherapy.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Does Prof. Mou treat brain metastases from lung cancer?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Mou has published research on neurosurgical resection outcomes for lung cancer brain metastases, including in patients with poor performance status who might otherwise be considered ineligible for surgery.

items.question: Does Prof. Mou use AI-based tools in glioma diagnosis?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Mou co-developed a multimodal AI model integrating imaging, radiomics and clinical data to predict glioblastoma molecular subtypes and prognosis, published in the Journal of Neurosurgery.
